name: MKT_IMP_MAP_COLUMNS
description: This table stores the  column by column detail mapping information for an import job.

columns.name: MAP_COLUMN_ID
columns.description: Primary key

columns.name: TXN_VO_ATTR_LEN
columns.description: This column specifies Fusion Table Column Width

columns.name: INT_VO_ATTR_NAME
columns.description: This column specifies the interface attribute name

columns.name: INT_VO_ATTR_COL
columns.description: The column saves the column name of the interface table for the corresponding INT_VO_ATTR_NAME

columns.name: TXN_VO_ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Transaction VO Attribute Name corresponding to the interface VO Attribute

columns.name: TXN_VO_ATTR_TYPE
columns.description: This column specifies the datatype of the transaction VO Attribute

columns.name: TXN_VO_ATTR_COL
columns.description: The column saves the column name of the base table for the corresponding TXN_VO_ATTR_NAME

columns.name: TXN_VO_ATTR_TABLE
columns.description: The column saves the value of the base table name

columns.name: MAP_COLUMN_NUM
columns.description: alternate key

columns.name: IMPORT_MAP_ID
columns.description: Identifies the parent mapping (foreign key to MKT_IMP_MAP.IMPORT_MAP_ID)

columns.name: IMP_FIELD_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: Field Sequence Number

columns.name: IMP_FIELD_NAME
columns.description: Stores field name which is extracted from the import file

columns.name: LOGIC_OBJ_NAME
columns.description: Mapped VO name

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Mapped table name

columns.name: OBJECT_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Object display name

columns.name: LOGIC_OBJ_COL_NAME
columns.description: Mapped VO attribute name

columns.name: OBJ_COL_NAME
columns.description: Mapped table column name

columns.name: OBJ_COL_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Object field display name

columns.name: SAMPLE_VAL
columns.description: Sample Value

columns.name: REQD_FIELD_FLAG
columns.description: Required Field Flag

columns.name: IGNORE_FIELD_FLAG
columns.description: Ignore field flag

columns.name: ALLOW_FIELD_UPDATE
columns.description: Allow  field update flag

columns.name: EXACT_MATCH_FLAG
columns.description: Exact match flag

columns.name: COLUMN_WIDTH
columns.description: Column width

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Object of the mapped column

columns.name: SOURCE_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Source File Name to store the name of the file used to do the import of the data in file import

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: MAP_COLUMN_TYPE
columns.description: It specifies whether the mapping column is an EXTERNAL column (specified in CSV file by customer) or an INTERNAL column (not specified by user in csv file, but needed internally by File Import framework). It will have possible values as  values as INTERNAL and EXTERNAL

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
